name: My Neighbour is a Bunny Demon
source:
Wayne is a mild-mannered zookeeper who's just moved into a new neighborhood. His life takes a turn for the strange when he meets his eccentric new neighbor, Zoy. She's mean, mysteriously alluring, and will threaten Wayne with death several times.

Entangled by a whirlwind romance, Wayne finds himself thrust into a web of paranormal plots and perils. The corpse of a dead girl, humanoid fish demons, Zoy's increasingly erratic behavior- are they all connected? Wayne's own sanity is pushed to the brink as he finds himself forced to press forward and unravel the countless mysteries endangering his life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2435610/]Steam[/url]]
